description: This file defines a custom Log4J appender called MemoryAppender for the OpenMRS project. The class stores recent log events in a circular buffer for later retrieval, supporting configurable buffer size. It includes builder pattern implementation, plugin annotations, and methods for accessing stored log entries.

classes.name: MemoryAppender
classes.description: A custom Log4J appender that buffers recent log events in a circular buffer, with configurable size. It extends AbstractAppender and supports dynamic creation via a factory method.

classes.name: MemoryAppender.MemoryAppenderBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing MemoryAppender instances with specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: createAppender
methods.description: Factory method annotated with @PluginFactory to create and initialize a MemoryAppender with specified attributes.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a log event to the internal circular buffer.

methods.name: getLogLines
methods.description: Retrieves buffered log events as a list of string representations.
